actor.reason:
REACHED THE GOAL.

I added five errands and chores. Adding tasks was quick, and Enter worked without needing to click Add. Checkboxes marked tasks complete, crossed them out, and updated the “left” count. “Clear completed” removed the two finished tasks.

I would not keep using Taskly because:

- The empty list initially displayed a large “undefined” item with “0 left.”
- The filters were reversed: **Active** showed my completed tasks, while **Completed** showed my unfinished tasks.
- A longer task title was cut off, so I could not read the full text.
- While editing, clicking **Save** twice appeared to do nothing. Pressing Enter finally saved the change.
- Most importantly, refreshing the page erased all three remaining tasks and brought back “undefined.” I would expect a to-do list to retain tasks between visits.

I hesitated around the unresponsive Save button and the contradictory filters. Losing the list on refresh was the deciding issue. No terminal was needed during this web-app trial.
